# VSE Corporation Announces Investor Day Event in New York City


October 14, 2026 7:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_a8afa62431311512df3e84c67b92720a/vsecorp/news/2026-10-14_VSE_Corporation_Announces_Investor_Day_Event_in_419.pdf)


**Event to feature executive presentations, a product and service showcase, and opportunities to engage with VSE’s broader leadership team**


MIRAMAR, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- VSE Corporation (“VSE” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: VSEC, VSECU), a leading provider of aviation aftermarket distribution and repair services, announced today that it will host its 2026 Investor Day in New York City on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, beginning at 9:00 a.m. ET.


The event will combine executive presentations and a Q&A session with an in-person showcase of VSE Aviation’s product and service capabilities. In-person attendees will also have time to engage directly with the Company’s broader leadership team for a closer look at VSE’s businesses and the capabilities that support its customers.


**Attend in Person**


The in-person experience will include executive presentations, a Q&A session, product and service displays, and opportunities for direct conversations with leaders from across VSE Aviation. Together, these activities will give attendees a firsthand view of the Company’s aviation aftermarket capabilities and the team behind them.


**Webcast Details**


A live audio webcast of the executive presentations and Q&A session will be available at[https://irday.vsecorp.com](https://irday.vsecorp.com/) , where related materials will also be posted. A replay will be available for 12 months following the event.


The product and service showcase and dedicated time with VSE Aviation’s leadership team will be available exclusively to in-person attendees.


Both in-person and virtual attendees are required to register at[https://irday.vsecorp.com](https://irday.vsecorp.com/) . After registering, participants will receive a confirmation email with event details.


For more information about this event, please contact VSE’s Investor Relations atinvestors@vsecorp.com .


**ABOUT VSE CORPORATION** VSE is a leading provider of aviation distribution and repair services for the commercial and business and general aviation (B&GA) aftermarkets. Headquartered in Miramar, Florida, VSE is focused on significantly enhancing the productivity and longevity of its customers' high-value, business-critical assets. VSE’s aftermarket parts distribution and maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services support engine component and engine and airframe accessory part distribution and repair services for commercial and B&GA operators. For more detailed information, please visit VSE's website at[www.vsecorp.com](http://www.vsecorp.com/) .
